workflows.description: Full Intelligence pipeline: consolidates context, diagnoses, calculates gaps, prioritizes, proposes a replanning, audits it, and produces preview-only task proposals. Never writes canonical state.

approval_gate.description: A execução em si é geração de proposta, não execução — não exige aprovação. As task_proposals resultantes exigem aprovação explícita antes de virarem tarefas (workflow apply-approved-tasks).

workflows.description: Assembles a read-only, evidence-traceable ROPRE draft for the resolved Quarter.
natural_language_triggers: monte o rascunho de check-in da <cliente>

approval_gate.description: Gera somente um draft transitório; nada é persistido até close-ropre save_draft, que é um pedido explícito separado.

workflows.description: Persists and advances an already-prepared ROPRE draft through draft -> ready -> completed.
natural_language_triggers: salve o rascunho de ropre da <cliente>
marque o ropre da <cliente> como pronto

approval_gate.description: apply exige preview_hash aprovado e pedido explícito do operador (skills/close-ropre/SKILL.md seção 5).

workflows.description: Bridges operator-approved task proposals (from generate-tasks) into manage-task-ledger operations, validates the approval hash isn't stale, previews, and only applies with an explicit, non-stale approval.
natural_language_triggers: crie as tarefas aprovadas da <cliente> no ledger

approval_gate.description: Exige um approval com status approved/partially_approved, approved_payload_hash correspondente exatamente ao task_proposal vigente (scripts/lib/approval.py) — aprovação stale bloqueia toda a operação material.

workflows.notes: A ponte propriamente dita (scripts/lib/task_bridge.py) nunca escreve tasks.json — só constrói as operations que manage-task-ledger preview/apply consome; com o ledger vigente, um replay idêntico retorna no_change antes de chegar ao create_task, e um mesmo task_id com conteúdo divergente bloqueia.

workflows.description: Maps an approved, canonical task into an eKyte-shaped payload and previews (or, only with a real transport, applies) publication. No real programmatic eKyte transport is known/available today — see docs/workflows/ekyte-publication.md.
natural_language_triggers: publique as tarefas aprovadas da <cliente> no ekyte
required_capabilities: canonical task (pending, no incompatible external binding)

approval_gate.description: apply exige approval_id vinculado exatamente à task canônica, além de um transport disponível — hoje somente FakeEkyteTransport (testes) existe; sem transport real, apply produz um pacote de exportação manual, nunca afirma publicação real.

workflows.notes: Classificação honesta: IMPLEMENTED_DRY_RUN. Nenhuma API/connector/credencial de eKyte foi encontrada documentada no workspace ou no engine — ver docs/workflows/ekyte-publication.md.

workflows.description: Compares the local task ledger's external bindings against eKyte (via whatever transport is configured) and reports MATCHED/LOCAL_ONLY/REMOTE_ONLY/STATUS_MISMATCH/DUE_DATE_MISMATCH/UNKNOWN. Never auto-corrects.
natural_language_triggers: reconcilie as tarefas da <cliente> com o ekyte
confira divergências de tarefas da <cliente> no ekyte
optional_capabilities: real eKyte transport (not available today — falls back to UNKNOWN for all bound tasks)

approval_gate.description: Somente leitura/comparação; qualquer correção é uma decisão separada do operador.

workflows.description: Mid-week operational snapshot: what's planned/completed/pending/overdue/blocked this week, changed evidence/results, risks, and actions needing decision. Never invents execution.

End-of-week operational snapshot: promised vs. executed, blockers, BI movement, SMART evidence, open flags, carry-forward candidates, and inputs for the next ROPRE. Never creates carry-over automatically.
